text: This report submits the draft 2024 financial statements of the Board for approval. The Policy and Finance Committee reviewed the financial statements on May 13, 2025 and recommended it for approval by the Board.

The Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo: 1. Approved the draft Financial Statement for the year ended December 31, 2024 as attached in Attachment 1 to the report (May 23, 2025) from the Chief Transformation Officer, Toronto Zoo.
